result.topic_en: Draft remarks on functions not satisfying the conditions for Fourier representability, on functions with infinitely many maxima and minima, and on functions whose difference quotient becomes infinite infinitely often in arbitrarily small intervals; followed by scratch substitution calculations for integrals such as $\int e^{1/x}dx$.

items.english: that a function which has infinitely many maxima and minima can be integrable throughout without being representable by Fourier's series.

oder vielmehr der Grenzwerth v. $\frac{F(x+\alpha)-F(x-\alpha)}{2\alpha}$, wenn $\alpha$ unendlich
